info.title: audience-workflow-api
info.description: FastAPI BFF for Audience Workflow. Stateless — talks to NocoDB (control plane), Dagster (pipelines) and Athena (data plane).

post.description: Dedicated fixed scheduler capability required only for global analysis claims; it is not a Human, Agent, legacy, or Personal key. Callers MUST provide this header: an omitted or invalid value receives 403, while an unconfigured server capability receives 503. OpenAPI marks it optional only so this domain gate can return those errors instead of FastAPI's generic 422.

SynthesisRepresentativeVoice.title: SynthesisRepresentativeVoice
SynthesisRepresentativeVoice.description:
One redacted excerpt selected for an immutable synthesis revision.

``translation`` remains nullable so deployed v1 synthesis revisions and
rolling-deploy conclusion writers remain compatible. New Hermes tooling
requires the field before it calls the public endpoint.

VocSynthesisEvidenceV1.title: VocSynthesisEvidenceV1
VocSynthesisEvidenceV1.description:
One bounded, producer-redacted evidence item used only as input.

Unlike Agent-authored facts, voices, and reports, this excerpt has already
crossed the canonical ``EvidenceItem`` normalization/redaction boundary.
Preserve it exactly, including a legal public source URL; applying the
output-text prompt/link filter here would silently discard claimable work.

WorkspaceSharedAudienceMaterialization.title: WorkspaceSharedAudienceMaterialization
WorkspaceSharedAudienceMaterialization.description:
Server-resolved reusable Audience snapshot binding.

This is deliberately an opaque control-plane reference.  It contains no
filter, SQL, recipient data, or caller-selected storage location.
